label: TikTok
terms_note: Free; app must pass TikTok's Content Posting API AUDIT — unaudited clients can only post to PRIVATE accounts / SELF_ONLY and are capped to test users (error unaudited_client_can_only_post_to_private_accounts); scopes video.publish (direct post) and video.upload (upload to the creator's inbox / drafts); 6 requests per minute per user access token; spam_risk_too_many_posts daily cap; PULL_FROM_URL needs a verified domain; UX rules (creator must see privacy options, commercial-content disclosure via brand_content_toggle / brand_organic_toggle, is_aigc label).

tools.name: publish_image
tools.endpoint: POST https://open.tiktokapis.com/v2/post/publish/content/init/ (photo post; photos must come from a verified domain/URL prefix)

tools.name: publish_video
tools.endpoint: POST /v2/post/publish/creator_info/query/ → POST /v2/post/publish/video/init/ (FILE_UPLOAD or PULL_FROM_URL) → PUT chunks → GET /v2/post/publish/status/fetch/

tools.name: reply_comment
tools.endpoint: — (no comment write API outside the Research API / Business API)

tools.name: delete
tools.endpoint: — (no delete endpoint in the Content Posting API)

auth: 1. TikTok for Developers app → add the Content Posting API product → Login Kit (web) OAuth 2.0 with scopes
2. Access token 24 h, refresh token 365 days (`POST /v2/oauth/token/`).
3. **Audit:** until the app passes TikTok's Content Posting audit, posts can only be made to private accounts /

endpoints.purpose: privacy options, duet/stitch/comment flags, max video length
`post_info{title ≤ 2200, privacy_level, disable_duet, disable_comment, disable_stitch, video_cover_timestamp_ms, brand_content_toggle, brand_organic_toggle, is_aigc}`, `source_info{source FILE_UPLOAD

endpoints.call: Display API (`/v2/video/list/`, `/v2/video/query/` with like/comment/share/view counts); comment management needs the Commercial / Research programs

reference.limits: - 6 requests per minute per user access token; `spam_risk_too_many_posts` daily cap; `reached_active_user_cap` for unaudited apps. - `PULL_FROM_URL` only from a domain verified in the developer portal. - Free; TikTok Developer Terms + Content Posting API guidelines (no automated engagement, disclose branded content).

config_fields.name: privacy_level
config_fields.help: privacy_level for direct photo posts: one of the creator's privacy_level_options from /v2/post/publish/creator_info/query/ (PUBLIC_TO_EVERYONE, MUTUAL_FOLLOW_FRIENDS, FOLLOWER_OF_CREATOR, SELF_ONLY). Unaudited apps can only use SELF_ONLY.

fields.name: client_key
fields.help: Client key of your TikTok for Developers app (https://developers.tiktok.com/apps).

fields.name: client_secret
fields.help: Client secret of the same app.

fields.name: refresh_token
fields.help: The creator's refresh_token from the Login Kit authorization-code exchange (POST /v2/oauth/token/, valid 365 days) with scopes user.info.basic, video.publish, video.list. Access tokens (24 h) are minted from it; a rotated refresh_token replaces it (persisted when PLATFORM_MCP_STATE_DIR is set).

me.note: GET /v2/user/info/ (user.info.basic): open_id, union_id, avatar_url, display_name of the authorised creator.

publish_image.note: POST /v2/post/publish/content/init/ (video.publish) direct-posts up to 35 photos pulled from URLs (the domain or URL prefix must be verified for your app; url_ownership_unverified otherwise), `text` as the description (≤4000). `id` is the publish_id; publishing is asynchronous (poll /v2/post/publish/status/fetch/). Unaudited apps can only post SELF_ONLY; 6 requests/minute per token; the creator must have been shown TikTok's posting UX (creator_info/query) first.

analytics_post.note: POST /v2/video/query/ (video.list) for one of the creator's own videos: like_count, comment_count, share_count, view_count, title, share_url.

not_offered.publish_text: The Content Posting API posts only video or photo content ('media_type ... Currently only PHOTO is allowed' for /v2/post/publish/content/init/, https://developers.tiktok.com/doc/content-posting-api-reference-photo-post); there is no text-only post.
not_offered.read_comments: Comment data is not in the Display API video object (fields: id, create_time, cover_image_url, share_url, video_description, duration, …, like_count, comment_count, share_count, view_count; https://developers.tiktok.com/doc/tiktok-api-v2-video-query); comment lists are only in the separately approved Research API.
not_offered.reply_comment: No comment-reply endpoint exists in the Login Kit / Display / Content Posting APIs (https://developers.tiktok.com/doc/tiktok-api-v2-video-query lists only counts).
not_offered.read_mentions: No mentions endpoint exists in the Display or Content Posting APIs (https://developers.tiktok.com/docs/en/content-posting-api-get-started).
not_offered.delete: The Content Posting API has no delete call (https://developers.tiktok.com/docs/en/content-posting-api-get-started: init, upload, status fetch only); posts are deleted in the TikTok app.

adapter.terms: TikTok Developer Terms and Content Posting API guidelines: app audit required before public posting; show the creator's privacy options and commercial-content disclosures before posting.

evidence: host open.tiktokapis.com: DNS ok, TLSv1.3 (DigiCert Inc)
